detailed_preview_html:
You buy a can of spray on Saturday. By Wednesday the ants are back, and they've brought friends.

Pests rarely give up after one round of DIY. They live in places you can't reach, they breed faster than you'd think, and they always pick the worst timing, like the night before guests arrive or the week your cafe is due for an inspection.

If you're looking for dependable pest control Geelong locals can book without the runaround, this page covers what pests are doing around here, what to watch for, and what a good treatment actually looks like.
detailed_expanded_html:
What Pests Are Up To in Geelong Through the Year

Geelong's mild, damp, coastal weather does a lot of the work for pests. The problem changes with the season, so it helps to know what's coming.

Spring: Ants, Wasps and Termite Swarms

As things warm up, ant colonies wake up and head straight for your kitchen. Queen wasps start building nests, and a nest the size of a golf ball is far easier to deal with than one the size of a football. Termites also swarm on warm, muggy days. Winged insects clustering around a window or light are worth a closer look.

Summer: Cockroaches, Spiders and Fleas

Heat and humidity speed up breeding. Cockroaches settle into bathrooms, laundries and the gap behind the fridge. Spiders follow the insects. Fleas multiply quickly once they get into a home with pets, and a few bites on your ankles can mean thousands of eggs in the carpet.

Autumn and Winter: Rats and Mice Move Indoors

When the temperature drops, rodents go looking for warmth. A mouse can squeeze through a gap about the width of a pen, and the quiet roof void of an older home is ideal for a nest. Most people notice it at night, with light scratching or quick little footsteps overhead.

Older Homes, Timber and Termites: Where They Hide

Geelong has plenty of weatherboard houses, raised floors and mature gardens. That's exactly the setting termites like. The scary part is that they eat timber from the inside, so a wall can look perfectly fine while the frame behind it is being hollowed out.

A proper termite inspection covers the roof void, subfloor, timber around bathrooms and laundries, fence posts, garden edging and retaining walls. We check for moisture problems too, because damp timber attracts them.

Picture buying a 1950s weatherboard home. It looks great and the price feels right. A pre-purchase check that finds activity in the bathroom wall before settlement can save you a very expensive surprise. For homes already lived in, an inspection once a year is a sensible habit.

When It Can't Wait Until Next Week

Some situations are urgent. A wasp nest above the front door with kids coming and going. Rats in the ceiling of a house with a newborn. A cockroach running across the kitchen of a restaurant during service. Bed bugs after a holiday stay.

When it's like this, tell us when you call. We'll do our best to get a technician out quickly, and we'll explain what we're doing so you're not left guessing. Fast pest control Geelong callouts are about getting the situation under control first, then sorting out the cause.

Renting, Selling or Running a Business? Your Needs Are Different

Tenants and Landlords

Pest problems often surface right before a routine inspection or at the end of a lease. Who pays usually depends on the cause and what your agreement says, so check that first. Either way, a written treatment record helps keep things clear for everyone involved.

Home Sellers

A recent pest report can calm nervous buyers. If an earlier problem was treated, having the paperwork ready makes the conversation easier.

Cafes, Shops and Warehouses

For a business, one bad review about a cockroach can stick around for years. Regular scheduled visits keep pests out of food areas and give you records ready for audits. We can plan visits around your trading hours so service isn't disrupted.

Treatments With Kids, Pets and Gardens in Mind

Tell us who lives at your place. A toddler who crawls everywhere, a cat that sleeps on the windowsill, chickens out the back, a veggie patch, a fish tank. All of it matters.

We choose products and placement to suit. Baits go where children and pets can't reach them, and we'll tell you how long to keep everyone out of a treated area and what to cover or move beforehand. If you have a specific worry, raise it on the phone and we'll plan around it.

What Affects the Price of Pest Control in Geelong

Nobody enjoys a vague quote, so here's what actually changes the price:

  • The type of pest
  • The size of the property
  • How far the infestation has spread
  • How hard the area is to reach, such as a tight roof void or a double storey home
  • Whether follow up visits are needed

A few ants on a kitchen bench is a small job. Establishing rodents with several entry points takes more time and more materials. We give you a clear price before starting, so you can weigh up your pest control Geelong options without pressure.

Book Pest Control Geelong Before It Gets Bigger

We work across the city, from Belmont and Newtown to Corio, Lara, Norlane and Armstrong Creek, and out along the coast to Torquay and Ocean Grove. If you're not sure we reach your street, just ask.

Our team also looks after other parts of Victoria. If you have a property or business elsewhere, you can find our local services for pest control Melton, pest control Point Cook and pest control Richmond on their own pages.

Call +61 434 660 060 or send the quote form today for reliable pest control service. The sooner someone takes a look, the sooner you can get back to a home that feels like yours again.
